packet_id: REPLACE: unique packet id, e.g. WP-20260101-topic
boot_path: REPLACE: task class — docs_cleanup | validator_change | implementation | behavior_repair | governance_change | continuation
affected_area: REPLACE: the surface this packet is allowed to change
concept: REPLACE: what this change is, in one paragraph, written BEFORE the work starts
out_of_scope: REPLACE: adjacent things this packet deliberately does NOT touch
behavior_validators: REPLACE: command that proves the changed behavior works (tests, replay, smoke)
structure_validators: REPLACE: command that proves the repo/control structure is intact (schema check, lint, topology validator)
real_stop_condition_if_stopping: none | explicit_user_instruction_required | blocked | missing_required_files_credentials_tools_licenses_or_assets | validation_failure_unrepairable | external_action_not_explicitly_authorized | explicit_user_stop | scope_boundary_reached
_convention: Fill every REPLACE: value before starting work. A commit with any remaining 'REPLACE:' string must be rejected by hook/CI (e.g. `git grep -n 'REPLACE:' -- <packet-path>`). The packet is a pre-declaration, not a post-hoc report.
